_comment: Findings that exist today and are not regressions of the change that introduced this audit. Recorded so the audit can fail on anything new. All of them are one story: a pale section fill or a sankey flow that is faint against the diagram surface in both color modes — between 1.36:1 and 1.54:1 — and the dark mode surface is the slightly darker of the two, so the pair straddles the visibility floor the audit compares against. Getting rid of them needs a design decision about the section palette rather than a per-mode fix; sankey brings its own colors and does not read theme variables at all. Run npm run audit:mermaid -- --strict for the full WCAG 1.4.11 picture.
